scenario can require smart-key (proximity) entry and push-button start, excluding a car only when its equipment is confirmed absent and noting \\u0027confirm push-button start\\u0027 when it is unknown.\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022Each vehicle carries an equipment status for smart-key entry and for push-button start, each one of present, absent, or unknown, with its source; precedence is the listing\\u0027s window sticker or factory equipment list, then a factory trim table (model, model-year range, trim), and dealer description text never confirms or rules out either feature.\u0022,\u0022The walk\\u0027s detail extraction reads the window sticker or equipment list when the page has one and records the two features as stated (\\u0027Smart Key System\\u0027 or proximity entry with push-button start versus \\u0027Keyless Entry\\u0027 fob and turn key); existing cars pick it up on a walk with --revisit.\u0022,\u0022A factory trim table lives in one data file in the repo, starts empty, and is read at rank time; when the table gives a definite answer for a car\\u0027s model, year and trim, it fills an unknown status.\u0022,\u0022A scenario setting (for example filters.requiredFeatures with \\u0027smart-key entry\\u0027 and \\u0027push-button start\\u0027) makes rank exclude a car whose status for a required feature is absent, with the reason named, and show a \\u0027confirm push-button start\\u0027 style note when the status is unknown; odo show prints both statuses and their sources.\u0022,\u0022Tests cover the precedence (sticker over dealer text, using the JTDBCMFE7P3014805 shape: dealer text claims push-button start, sticker lists only \\u0027Keyless Entry, Power Door Locks\\u0027), the exclusion, and the unknown note; docs/scenario.md and docs/walk.md describe it.\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Brian\\u0027s ruling 2026-10-03, relayed by the run session: a candidate must have keyless or smart-key entry and push-to-start. Unknown handling (exclude only when confirmed absent) is the run session\\u0027s recommendation, reversible. Evidence: #3 JTDBCMFE7P3014805 (2023 Corolla Hybrid LE): dealer description claims push-button start and leather, while the same listing\\u0027s window sticker lists only Keyless Entry and cloth seats. The trim table\\u0027s contents come later in a separate task from a sourced research note; this task builds the mechanism with an empty table. Add the requirement to the live scenario only if the scenario file lives in the repo; otherwise document how to set
